72.title: [PLAN-D10]: Outreach Sequencer SKILL.md + 5-touch worker
72.error: The brief is still underspecified, and the thread has no Architect answers to the two earlier needs-brief verdicts, so nothing resolves the ambiguity. It doesn't violate §8 Never and doesn't touch `decisions/` or `logs/`. Writing to `agents/` and `services/` on a branch is allowed, so scope isn't the problem. The problem is missing specifics. Only `agents/outreach-sequencer/SKILL.md` has an exact target. The worker is most of the work and has no file path or service location. The brief doesn't give the 5-touch cadence (timing, channels, copy source). It doesn't say how the one-pager audit is produced or located for attachment to touch 2. It doesn't name the GHL API endpoints, the auth/secrets handling, the reply-webhook route, or the Sales Desk interface. The DoD items "automated through GHL API" and "routes intent to Sales Desk" can't be verified as written. They need a mock, fixture, or test-based acceptance criterion. This system sends real prospect communications, so building it on guesses is unsafe. Outreach and sales automation is also outside normal web-builder discipline, so the owner needs confirming. The earlier questions were generic, so the questions below are more concrete.
